title: Inspect retained sparse parameter trigger candidates
changes: Narrow ordinary sparse-parameter recovery with program context and mission-source joins over retained snapshots.
Trace a zero-override event starter and record the limits of the retained pending-field search.
validation: Guarded read-only scans inspect nine prior candidates and 370 retained snapshot paths, with 279 distinct readable EUR payloads. All 27 program 158 contexts have cursor 28 after the mode-0 instruction at offset 22. A separate source join finds 20 physical mission candidates with a nonzero parameter and a mode-0 program; none matches the saved selected-mission value in those 279 payloads. The first broader join failed at Python syntax parsing before source reads; its corrected check passed. Evidence: target/validation/units/e128-parameter-mode0-context-candidates-syolhe_k/, e128-parameter-prior-script-contexts-xypp8e8t/, e128-parameter-all-mode0-mission-candidates-xvqpelh1/ and e128-parameter-all-mode0-mission-candidates-fixed-4skuahmi/.

Pinned original code clears 02003c28 and uses offset a4 from the object at 03002810 for an event-starter path. A guarded read of 279 retained EUR payloads finds 88 plausible root/view pointers and one nonzero field, event 58 parameter 0, with no key168/nonzero-parameter candidate. Evidence: target/validation/units/e128-parameter-pending-world-event-lc91avw3/.
limitations: Context pointers and saved mission values do not prove scheduling, availability, absence of indirect paths or branch returns. The positive ordinary read and paired comparison remain open; no guest execution or performance measurements.

An unrestricted 256-entry stride-264 RAM scan lacked proof of row ownership and is rejected as a scene selector; its diagnostic remains at target/validation/units/e128-parameter-mode0-physical-quest-rows-_x9xnsnq/. Plausible root/view pointers do not establish live task identity or event availability.
